# Listive

Listive styles outlines with differentiated headers, custom spacing and font pairings so that insight-led points stand out. The interface is kept subtle and low-contrast, with list-focused tweaks aimed at atomic notes. Its recorded description suggests pairing it with the Outliner plugin and MCL snippets for column, card and gallery layouts.

![Listive screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/efemkay/obsidian-listive-theme/HEAD/thumbnail.jpg)
